translations.en: A town sealed in mist.
A sky that obscured the sunlight, yet still let its presence be felt.
Looking at that sky brought back the words you had heard:
"A town imprisoned in a cursed magical mist."
Now, however, the legend of a town whose people would be killed by its curse
stood on the verge of being proven true.
To protect the final seal, @7rChu Lu Gah@0r had built
the seal that imprisoned this entire town. With it broken, the final seal
was as good as laid bare.
Even now, in this situation,
you still did not fully understand what that final seal held captive.
Something that might bring disaster upon the world.
A mysterious, ill-defined being that might destroy
not only this town, but the entire world.
Whatever happened, you could not let the end come.
That was true of both this town and the world.
Simply because you had wandered into this imprisoned town,
the hand of fate had turned and pointed at you.
And yet,
to be saddled with the burden of saving the world
